sections.text_helper: Section 34.6.15 "TIM timer input selection register (TIM_TISEL)" in chapter 34 (General-purpose timers (TIM12)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1331.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x05C
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:8 TI2SEL[3:0]: selects tim_ti2_in[15:0] input
0000: TIM_CH2 input (tim_ti2_in0)
0001: tim_ti2_in1
...
0100: tim_ti2_in15
Refer to Section34.3.2: TIM12 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
Bits 7:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 3:0 TI1SEL[3:0]: selects tim_ti1_in[15:0] input
0000: TIM_CH1 input (tim_ti1_in0)
0001: tim_ti1_in1
...
1111: tim_ti1_in15
Refer to Section34.3.2: TIM12 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
